title: How to become a NSW Livestock Loading Scheme (NSWLLS) driver
summary: This page explains the requirements and process for becoming an accredited NSW Livestock Loading Scheme (NSWLLS) driver.
intro:
Drivers who transport livestock by road in NSW and operate a vehicle under the NSWLLS must be accredited.

To become an accredited NSWLLS driver you'll need to:

After you've been accredited, always carry your NSWLLS Driver Card in your vehicle.

You'll then need to renew your accreditation every 5 years.

For details visit NSW Livestock Loading Scheme Driver Learning and Assessment.
what_you_need: Be a driver who transports livestock by road in NSW and operates a vehicle under the NSWLLS.
Carry your NSWLLS Driver Card in your vehicle after accreditation.

faqs.q: What must I do if I transport livestock by road in NSW?
faqs.a: If you transport livestock by road in NSW and operate a vehicle under the NSWLLS, you must be accredited.

faqs.q: How often do I need to renew my NSWLLS accreditation?
faqs.a: You will need to renew your accreditation every 5 years.

faqs.q: What should I do after I become an accredited NSWLLS driver?
faqs.a: Always carry your NSWLLS Driver Card in your vehicle.
